headline: Malawi Faces Nationwide Fuel Supply Crisis Amid Protests
summary: Malawi is experiencing a nationwide fuel supply crisis, prompting the Human Rights Defenders Coalition to threaten countrywide demonstrations demanding the removal of Energy Minister Jean Chifuniro Mathanga.
why: Fuel shortages disrupt transportation, agriculture, and manufacturing supply chains, exerting inflationary pressures on domestic economies.

impacts.name: Malawi
impacts.why: The nationwide fuel crisis directly impacts economic activity and logistics across the country.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
